composition_subtypes.role: decide custom a,b,c order to avoid T subsequence

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy decision selects custom order for a,b,c based on T, then sorts remaining characters to build lexicographically smallest valid string.
payload.rationale: Counts a,b,c, sorts extras; greedy rule chooses acb order when T=abc and all present, else abc, effectively a custom sort for the entire string.
